articles.title: Game 158: Guardians at Red Sox lineups and notes
articles.description: Sonny Gray will be on the mound when the Red Sox look to snap a three-game losing streak against Cleveland.

articles.title: Despite looming nor’easter, MLB not planning to move Red Sox-Cubs series out of Boston
articles.description: Team officials met with the league Tuesday to discuss contingency plans. While the series won't mean much to Boston's seeding, it will deeply affect Chicago's.

articles.title: How MLB’s potential work stoppage can impact one of the Red Sox’ top prospects
articles.description: As a player in his third pro season, Franklin Arias isn’t on the 40-man roster. He doesn’t have to be added to it until after the 2027 season.

articles.title: Postseason secured, but Red Sox trending in wrong direction and Guardians take advantage to open series
articles.description: Reliever Erik Miller struggled again in taking the loss and the offense remained at a minimum. Pinch hitter Mickey Gasper’s tying homer in the eighth inning went for naught.

articles.title: Garrett Crochet steps up mound work by facing a hitter, ‘definitely making progress’ toward Red Sox return
articles.description: Crochet (shoulder) threw live batting practice to fellow Red Sox rehabber Ceddanne Rafaela prior to the series opener vs. the Guardians.

articles.title: Chad Tracy named Red Sox manager, ditching interim tag, after leading club to dramatic turnaround
articles.description: In electing to keep Tracy heading into an uncertain 2027, chief baseball officer Craig Breslow and team ownership maintain an extra degree of continuity.

articles.title: From canning Alex Cora to a deadline deal, Craig Breslow defied expectations with in-season gambles. They paid off.
articles.description: In a view perhaps informed by his playing career, Breslow has learned to remain open to uncomfortable in-season change.

articles.title: Game 157: Guardians at Red Sox lineups and notes
articles.description: Payton Tolle will be on the mound when the Red Sox open a three-game series with Cleveland Tuesday at Fenway Park.

articles.title: Yankees don’t expect Aaron Judge to be available for Wild Card Series
articles.description: Judge, who has been dealing with a sore right calf, had a platelet poor plasma injection during the team’s off-day on Monday

articles.title: Red Sox offense has been running on fumes down the stretch
articles.description: Even though they secured a postseason berth Sunday, the Red Sox have averaged 2.82 runs over the last 11 games, hitting .210 with a .621 OPS.

articles.title: The moments that marked the Red Sox’ path back to the postseason: ‘Oh, now it’s our turn’
articles.description: Improbably, incredibly, the Red Sox have come back from being 14 games under .500 to securing a spot in the postseason.

articles.title: Why are all the streets in this Utah subdivision named for Red Sox players? We asked.
articles.description: “Ready to blow my savings and move to Utah so I can live on Pedroia Street,” one commenter wrote on social media.

articles.title: Craig Breslow, his moves questioned all season, earned the right to celebrate with the Red Sox. He knew what he was doing.
articles.description: The Red Sox’ chief baseball officer was the subject of plenty of criticism this season, but his team turned things around and earned a postseason spot.

articles.title: Nothing came easy for these Red Sox this year. Isn’t it fitting their celebration was delayed, too?
articles.description: The Sox walked off the field after losing to the Rays, but returned to celebrate soon after when the Astros lost.

articles.title: Red Sox listless in losing series finale to Rays, but clinch postseason berth with Astros’ loss
articles.description: After winning on Friday, Boston scored two runs in the last two games against the Rays and was 1 for 15 with runners in scoring position, leaving 14 men on base.

articles.title: Alex Bregman sent to hospital for tests after being hit in the face by a foul ball while on deck
articles.description: Bregman, who played for the Red Sox last season, is second on the Cubs with 26 home runs and 89 RBIs.
